description: This file defines the Permission class within the Opencart admin startup controllers. It manages permission checks for routes, determining if the current user has access rights and redirecting to an error page if not.

classes.name: Permission
classes.description: Handles permission verification for routes in the Opencart admin startup process.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Checks whether the current user has permission to access a route. If access is denied, returns an error action; otherwise, returns null.
